item.title: Detecting penetrant indications with YOLO11l
item.author: jparedescolmenarejo@gmail.com (Jose Paredes)
item.description: A YOLO11l detector trained to find fluorescent penetrant indications in UV imagery. It flags suspicious regions well; precise sizing is where the numbers fall apart.

item.title: Detecting welding defects with YOLO11x
item.author: jparedescolmenarejo@gmail.com (Jose Paredes)
item.description: A weld seam, a workpiece, porosity and a catch-all Defect class: four things a single YOLO11x detector learns to localise. The structure and porosity work well; the long tail of defect morphologies is the real problem.

item.title: How subany.video works: live subtitles in the browser
item.author: jparedescolmenarejo@gmail.com (Jose Paredes)
item.description: subany.video is a small experiment with a deliberately narrow promise: paste a Twitch link and watch the stream with translated subtitles. The video, the speech recognition and the translation all run in the browser.
